decision_cruda.rationale: Both failures are confirmed by radio and CMMS. LH-04 at E569-12 is likely repaired by 11:30, so lending a loader there pays little. LH-09's heading is worth 2 oz/h, so I leave it in place. C512-10 has 136 t at 13.4 g/t (about 58 oz), and LH-01 is likely out until 13:30. LH-08 comes from a cheap infrastructure heading (0.5 oz/h) and arrives in 0.69 h. At 29 t/h it mucks about 95 t, or roughly 41 oz, for a development cost of about 2 oz. Central trucks have spare capacity (63+29 inflow against 91 t/h), so the stockpile won't back up.
